correctness.rationale: At infinity the Artin–Schreier cover has pole orders r and r^h+1, and the tame scalar quotient divides invariant pole valuations by r-1. The unique invariant monomials x^i y^j with i+2j=0 mod r-1 and 0<=j<r produce distinct residues mod r, ruling out cancellation. Their Apéry minima give the stated semigroup and gaps, with type and genus sums following exactly. Independent enumerations at (r,h)=(5,2),(7,3),(9,2),(11,2) verified weight and pseudo-Frobenius formulas; those finite cases do not prove generality. The algebraic proof does for all stated odd prime powers.
residual_risks: The prime p special case is substantially covered by earlier published semigroup work.
